evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: Arden says 'it will take around ten to fifteen minutes' but does not wait for affirmative yes—Jonathan agrees 'that's fine' but Arden immediately pivots to 'other than the price is there any biggest concerns' without the full framing about 'a quote you can depend on.'
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Arden: 'other than the price is there any biggest concerns that you're worried about this new so I can take note and make sure it's handled care.' Asked before probing logistics.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Jonathan raises tight stairwell concern—Arden acknowledges and pivots to reassurance, does not ask 'tell me more.' Jonathan raises storage unit stop—Arden says 'no issue' and explains pricing but does not probe deeper. Jonathan raises safe weight concern—Arden says 'I'll be taking note' and asks 'How many?' (one layer only). Shallow follow-up pattern throughout.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No reflection back. Arden acknowledges each concern individually but never summarizes: 'So what I'm hearing is...'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Property type (1BR apt), floor (second), rooms (1 bed), parking distance (75 feet), additional stops (storage unit with specifics), special items (4 safes, washer/dryer, 55-inch TV, mattress), destination (3BR house). Nearly all seven items covered.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Arden: 'Do you help, do you need help putting your Sam items in two boxes, like?' and expands with service options. Clearly offered.
evidence_quotes.box_count_asked: Arden: 'How many total number of boxes do you think, are we going to move for you maximum?' Jonathan estimates 30–40 boxes.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Arden provides typical range ('two and a half to three and a half hours' for 1BR) and personalizes heavily to this move: tight stairwell, walk distance, 4 safes, washer/dryer, TV, full packing, storage stop, 15–20 minute drive. Estimates 8.5–9.5 hours, $3,502.50 (or $3,024 split over two days).
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: Arden discloses $111/hour per mover, $150 transportation fee upfront. States '2.5 hour minimum,' 'fifteen minutes increments,' and 'no hidden fees.' $2,000 damage coverage built-in. Both fee transparency and commitment framing present.
evidence_quotes.feels_fair_then_silence: Arden never asks 'Does that feel fair?' or any variation. Moves directly to two-day option alternative without a pause for customer reaction.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee_delivered: Arden: 'we also have an on time guarantee, so, if the movers arrive late you start to get discount on your final bill.' Discount terms stated clearly.
evidence_quotes.damage_coverage_delivered: Arden: 'once you book this, you're going to get up to $2,000 free evaluation coverage. So, if anything gets damaged or gets broken during the move you can just give us a call to file a claim.' States $2,000 and no deductible framing ('free evaluation coverage'). Built-in stated implicitly but framed as a booking benefit, not explicitly 'no fine print.'
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: Arden does not ask 'Does that put those to rest?' or equivalent close after Two Promises delivery. Moves into two-day option without confirming promises landed.
evidence_quotes.final_concerns_check: Arden never asks 'What's still concerning you?' or 'What's still on your mind?' After pricing, pivots directly to two-day alternative and then to 'would you want to be put on the book.' No genuine final concerns check.
evidence_quotes.catch_all_asked: Arden does not ask 'Anything coming with you we haven't talked about?' or similar catch-all.
evidence_quotes.explicit_ask: Arden: 'So would you want to be put on the book sir?' But immediately followed by Arden offering an out: 'Can you send me a proposal via email or an estimate via email? I'm still shopping this around quite honestly.' This is customer-initiated and Arden accepts without re-asking, so the ask itself was clear but the close was soft and abandoned.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_mentioned: Arden: 'best part with Einstein moving we do not require any deposit or credit card details or upfront payment once you're already on the books.' No deposit / rate-lock framing stated.
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Arden never confirms date, phone, arrival window, crew size, addresses, or notes. Customer declines to book on this call and requests email. No confirmation occurred.

top_strength: Arden gathered exceptional logistics detail—property specs, parking distance, storage unit location, special items, destination address—and personalized the estimate directly to each complicating factor (tight stairwell, 4 safes, full packing, multi-stop routing), building credibility and accuracy.
coaching_note: After delivering the estimate, ask 'Does that feel fair to you?' and hold silence for the customer's true reaction before pivoting to alternatives—this is the highest-leverage moment to close, and rushing past it to offer a two-day split option abandoned the primary sale path.
